first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because it addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, while avoiding the potentially lower-quality revenue and margin risks of broad promotional pricing. I would verify the strongest onboarding result and the competitor-response pricing evidence before committing. Use a guarded test with qualified-revenue and retention-quality guardrails, since improved completion and activation may not automatically produce sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The verified evidence directly addresses the 4% completion decline and shows durable improvements in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, making it the strongest sustainable-revenue response and likely to support recovery in activation. Include qualified revenue, activation, and retention guardrails. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it increases signups and short-term qualified revenue, the verified cohort has 12% lower 30-day retention and fails to survive the first renewal cycle.
